title: Mike Vrabel, Drake Maye address the balance between decisiveness and recklessness

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Vrabel, Drake Maye address the balance between decisiveness and recklessness
sources.description: After a Week 2 win over the Steelers, Patriots coach Mike Vrabel didn't want to have his Sunday "ruined" by questions about the performance of quarterback Drake Maye.
